programs.title: Killer Safari: Big Cat Battle Compilation Season
programs.desc: Tourists hope to be able to take photos of the big cats.Meanwhile, they witness an elephant charging.Leopards fight for territory.Cheetahs must face crocodiles, and a lone lion must face a herd of buffaloes.

programs.title: America the Beautiful: Mighty Northwest
programs.desc: The Cascade Mountains located in the USA are among the most dangerous regions in North America.Among their peaks you can find as many as 13 volcanoes, 7 of which have erupted in the last 300 years.

programs.title: Killer Safari
programs.desc: South America is a diverse continent where you can meet creatures adapted to difficult conditions.Survival is not guaranteed and residents must be vigilant to avoid death.

programs.title: Wild Chile: Compilation 1
programs.desc: Chile is the longest country in the world with diverse ecosystems.The desert north and the hostile coastline to the south are home to many wild creatures.
